purpose: one limited CPU tree versus a frozen reproduced Ridge and market; development only
features: 94 official base columns plus 3 one-record-lagged training fields
preprocessing: training-only median imputation with empty columns kept, standardized values, all-column missing indicators

mapping.rule: clip(1 + 0.25 * forecast / rms_oof, 0, 2); neutral if rms_oof below floor
mapping.wire_precision: float32 allocations, matching official Python-float scalar transport

api_replay: 16 second-development-window rows per model; no reserved/mock rows
hypothesis: thresholds and feature interactions improve prediction and risk-adjusted allocation on both development windows
selection_policy: record all results; no tuning, ensemble, promotion or reserved evaluation
mapping_comparison: same fixed rule and strength; RMS estimated from each model own earlier OOF predictions
diagnostics: development forecast RMS relative to earlier OOF RMS
